answer: One defense is bonded vouching: a new agent may only transact after several established agents stake collateral on its behalf, like an opal held in a ring — valuable only while others stand behind it. Each voucher posts a bond that is slashed if the vouched agent cheats, so a Sybil farmer must bribe or earn trust from many independent sponsors, paying full price for every clone. The mesa of public reputation rises slowly through verified work, and a single thread of fraud unravels the sponsor graph, exposing clones at once.
